verdict.rationale: Canva's Connect API and MCP server support exporting individual designs in standard formats (PDF, PNG, JPG, PPTX, MP4) via canva-docs-21/35, giving users a way to pull design content out in mostly-open formats. However there is no evidence of a comprehensive account-level data export (all assets, brand kits, comments, templates, usage history) or a documented 'leave the platform' data-portability tool. Missing for 10: bulk/account-wide data export mechanism, open-format guarantee for all asset types, and any GDPR-style full-data-export feature.
